mentions.name: Papermill
mentions.description: Papermill is a document engine for AI that turns AI-generated content into polished documents using Press, a new document/templating language. It serves as a high-quality alternative to the common HTML-to-PDF route for document generation and is designed as a tool for AI agents. It ships an MCP server that lets models like Claude design fully-featured documents, which is used internally and by customers to quickly build new templates. Recently launched self-serve, with ongoing development of the typesetter and language.
mentions.problem: The HTML-to-PDF route many people take for document generation is limited; Papermill provides higher-quality document output.
